hero.title: Tulpar: Enterprise Next.js 16 Application Template
hero.description: A reference architecture engineered for building modern, scalable, and enterprise-ready web applications. Features modular application shells (Public, Auth, Admin), typed forms, Radix UI custom core components, and an educational Turkic culture atlas.

cultureCallout.title: Discover Tulpar & Ancient Turkic Culture
cultureCallout.description: Designed to inspire developers with 40+ authentic cultural symbols, Göktürk 4-direction color cosmology, legendary creatures, and an AI image prompt studio optimized for Midjourney, DALL-E, and Gemini.
features: 16 Cosmology & Art Colors (Ak, Kara, Gök, Kızıl, Sarı, etc.)
10 Nature, Tree & Floral Motifs (Tree of Life, Tulip, Rose, etc.)
14 Animals & Warrior Totems (Gray Wolf, Tulpar, Eagle, etc.)

featuresSection.title: Enterprise Architecture & Technical Foundations
featuresSection.description: The Tulpar template combines production-proven engineering patterns with modern enterprise web standards.

cards.title: Modern Core Architecture
cards.description: Maximized optimization between Server and Client Components powered by the Next.js 16 App Router.
points: Static and dynamic Metadata API integration
Automated sitemap, robots.txt, and llms.txt generation

cards.title: 30+ Custom Core Components
cards.description: Accessible, typed custom component system built with Radix UI instead of raw HTML primitives.
points: Button, Input, Select, Table, Dialog, Drawer, Card
Modern Date Picker, Tabs, Accordion, and Slider
Strict WCAG keyboard and screen reader accessibility

cards.title: 3 Distinct Application Shells
cards.description: Independent shell layouts configured for varying access tiers and user roles.
points: Public Shell: General public showcase and landings
Admin Shell: Advanced management and monitoring dashboard

cards.title: Zero "any" & Strict Validation
cards.description: Type safety and data integrity enforced across client and server boundaries.
points: Zod schemas for both client and server validation
React Hook Form integrated form management
250-line file limit and modular folder architecture

cards.title: Multi-Language & Theme System
cards.description: Seamless infrastructure for handling persistent user preferences.
points: Instant switching between Dark and Light themes
Cookie-backed server and client state synchronization

cards.title: Performance & Security
cards.description: Production-ready security headers, error boundaries, and Core Web Vitals optimizations.
points: Core Web Vitals tuning (LCP, CLS, INP)
Secure CSP, HSTS, and XSS protection headers

quickRoutesSection.title: Explore Template Routes
quickRoutesSection.description: Jump directly to any of the pre-configured application surfaces in Tulpar.
